metadata.latest_updates: July 2026: Verified PSD3/PSR status (political agreement Nov 2025, texts agreed April 2026, awaiting Official Journal publication), EU Instant Payments Regulation milestones, Visa VAMP 2026 thresholds, Mastercard ECP thresholds, PCI DSS v4.0.1 as sole active version, and Stripe Managed Payments general-availability status against primary sources. March 2026: Refreshed Stripe checkout and billing sources with Payment Links, flexible billing mode, Subscription Schedules, PayPal, and Pay by Bank. Added RevenueCat Web Billing and LemonSqueezy usage-based billing. Updated Open Banking adoption sources and replaced broad Braintree EOL wording with current PayPal deprecation-policy sources.
